name: How long does weather-resistant exterior paint typically last?

mainEntity.name: How long does weather-resistant exterior paint typically last?

acceptedAnswer.text: The lifespan of weather-resistant exterior paint varies based on the paint's quality, surface preparation, application techniques, and local climate conditions. Generally, high-quality weather-resistant paint can last 7 to 15 years, or even longer. Regular cleaning and maintenance can extend its life. In areas like DFW with significant temperature swings and strong sunlight, factors such as proper surface cleaning and priming by a professional before application are crucial to achieve maximum durability and lifespan.
acceptedAnswer.description: Weather-resistant exterior paint typically lasts 7-15 years, depending on paint quality, surface prep, application, and climate. Proper preparation in DFW's climate can extend its life.
